name: Model Checking Contest
description: The Model Checking Contest benchmarks tools on verifying properties of concurrent and distributed systems, often using Petri nets, transition systems, or other formal models. Systems compete on whether they can prove or refute properties and how efficiently they explore state spaces.
evaluation_method: Correctness of verification outcomes on formal models, usually combined with resource limits and scoring based on solved properties, runtime, and memory usage.
notes: Benchmark spans multiple model families and property types; exact contest scoring differs by track and year.
